label: Pixie dev team
blurb: Works Pixie's dev tickets on this machine: each ticket becomes an item on the repo's work list and a run (a manager with a helper in its own worktree), then a branch + PR, and the report with its screenshots goes back to Pixie for the owner's ✅/🔁/❌. Adds the DEV TEAM tab and /devteam.

settings.label: Dev-team token
settings.hint: the same value as Keys & services → Dev team token in Pixie

settings.label: Knowledge files the helper reads first
settings.hint: comma list; relative paths resolve inside the ticket's workspace folder
